title: Remove Core's Windows leftovers, dead catalogs and tests that test only themselves
goal: CEO 2026-11-22: foundation bloat free before features. Core is Linux-only yet carries a Windows installer and release scripts; 14 of 15 config catalogs are read by nothing; the standard-library builder is unused; several tests define and test their own copies of what they claim to cover.

reuse.searched: Core: the zero-configuration check reuses tests/mcp_runtime.rs and susi_paths::test_env::isolate_home; the secret-token prefixes move from the removed config file into susi-error beside their one reader. Nothing new is built.
